labels.species: Neutropenic female Swiss-Webster mice 24-26 g; intranasal P. aeruginosa PAO1 2 × 10^7 CFU
labels.record_level: Published population PK/PD parameter summaries: Mean, Median, SD; no individual concentration or per-regimen response records supplied.
labels.endpoint_window: PK: 11 times over 0-5 h; efficacy: lungs harvested 24 h after the start of therapy
labels.reason: The body contains reported population PK/PD parameters, including CL/F and Vc/F per animal, with Mean, Median and SD. Notes provide mouse infection context, PK and efficacy dosing, a strain MIC range and reported ELF targets. Requirement links identify partial source support, not complete input availability. Concentrations are explicitly confined to untranscribed figures; the supplied page contains no measured CFU response table or verified individual records. Published parameter SD is not established as individual PK variability. Vc/F is not Vss, and CL/F is not absolute CL. Numerical parameter columns have heterogeneous row-specific units: liters, liters/h, h-1, mg/liter and CFU/g; Hk-s and Hk-r have no stated unit. Endpoint mapping for the reported targets is explicitly NOT_VERIFIED.

evidence.quote: Neutropenic female Swiss-Webster mice 24-26 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.); intranasal P. aeruginosa PAO1 2 × 10^7 CFU. PK: single i.p. doses spanning 2.4-150 mg/kg given to four groups 5 h after inoculation (individual doses not listed); 11 times over 0-5 h, 2-3 mice per time; plasma and urea-corrected BAL (ELF) by LC-MS/MS.

Efficacy: "Five animal cohorts were administered meropenem i.p. at doses of 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, and 450 mg/kg every 4 h" (five cohorts but six doses, as printed) from 5 h after inoculation; lungs harvested 24 h after the start of therapy. Mice per cohort not stated; 5 mice killed for baseline counts.
Concentrations are in Figs. 1-2 only (not transcribed). Vc/F and CL/F are per animal (liters, liters/h), not per kg. Protein binding not reported. Table read once from the journal HTML.

Text: ELF penetration about 40% (median 39%); exposure targets "31.7%, 49.6%, and 49.8% of the dosing interval" time > MIC in ELF (abstract: 32%, 50%, 50%); endpoint mapping (2-log kill, 3-log kill, resistance suppression) paraphrased, NOT_VERIFIED. Strain MIC 0.5 to 1.0 mg/L.

findings.reason: MI001 remains NOT_FOUND, OPEN, needed_at adequacy. The supplied page reports fitted PD parameters and efficacy design, but no per-regimen measured CFU responses, numerical baseline counts, untreated growth controls or verified exposure-response pairs. It therefore cannot establish the matched-record comparison required by SC034–SC035 and DRQ29. This page-level assessment does not establish absence from unsearched attachment bodies.
findings.needed_material: Adequacy review of MI001; source-supported per-regimen responses, baseline/control values, experimental units, uncertainty and matching exposure, MIC, dosing and endpoint records. Keep the dependent comparison pending while retaining independent PK candidates.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T5:A90 explicitly preserves five animal cohorts but six listed meropenem doses. Mice per cohort and administered dose count are unspecified. No cohort-to-dose assignment or schedule reconciliation is supported.
findings.needed_material: Review the original efficacy cohort and dose assignments; preserve both printed alternatives until resolved and do not infer the number of administrations from the harvest time.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T5:A89 describes PK sampling, but A91 states that concentrations are in Figs. 1-2 only and are not transcribed. Reported model parameters are available candidates; concentration-time modeling observations and exact individual PK dose assignments are not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time figure extraction or original records with units, sampling origin, exact dosing, experimental-unit structure, assay limits and extraction provenance; retain modeling sufficiency for downstream assessment.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, OPEN, needed_at pk. The population parameter table supplies Mean, Median and SD, but does not define whether SD represents between-animal variability, parameter uncertainty or another distribution. Sampling counts do not establish individual trajectories or random effects.
findings.needed_material: During PK work, assess the original population-model variability definitions, contributing units, sampling structure and traceable individual records or reported variability. Record supported components or the resulting limitation without manufacturing individual variability.

findings.reason: The page reports plasma/ELF context, urea-corrected BAL measurement, VELF and ELF penetration, but contains no concentration observations or model equations. These are partial reported-parameter inputs; they do not establish support for including a pulmonary component.
findings.needed_material: Record the adequacy support assessment using source-model definitions, matrix/analyte basis and permitted observation evidence; distinguish an eligible component from exploratory reported-parameter constraints.

findings.reason: CL/F is reported in liters/h per animal after i.p. dosing. Absolute F, analyte composition, meropenem dose basis and the estimation method are not supplied. Vc/F is a distinct parameter and provides no Vss match.
findings.needed_material: Retain CL/F as LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED. Clarify intended parameter use, source estimation method, dose/analyte definitions and applicable F if absolute CL is requested; keep per-animal normalization.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T5:A89 and A92 identify PAO1 and a strain MIC range of 0.5 to 1.0 mg/L. The page does not specify the analysis MIC, method, medium, testing standard, replicate count or summary definition.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the matched meropenem PAO1 MIC and measurement context, including which value applies to each response/exposure record; do not select a value from the range here.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T5:A91 states that protein binding is not reported. The page does not identify direct unbound concentrations or a total/free concentration basis; time > MIC in ELF is not explicitly defined as a free-exposure index.
findings.needed_material: For the index-analysis branch, obtain an applicable binding input or directly measured free concentration and its definition before constructing free-exposure indices. Retain independent reported-parameter work without assuming fu equals one.

findings.reason: The page supports neutropenic PAO1 pneumonia context, treatment start, a 24 h endpoint and several doses at the same every-4-h interval. It supplies no interval/frequency variation, untreated growth-control values or verified PK-to-efficacy exposure transfer. PK and efficacy dose ranges also differ as printed.
findings.needed_material: Review regimen variation and source-supported PK-to-PD applicability, including dose-range differences and controls. Keep index ranking unresolved if the permitted design cannot separate the candidate indices.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T5:A92 reports ELF targets of 31.7%, 49.6% and 49.8%, alongside abstract values of 32%, 50% and 50%. Their endpoint mapping is explicitly paraphrased, NOT_VERIFIED; penetration ratio definitions are also unstated. These values do not establish a new target or ranking and cannot set primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.
findings.needed_material: Preserve all reported values and their text-versus-abstract provenance without reconciling them. Verify target definitions, endpoint mappings, concentration basis and penetration definitions before any permitted downstream use, and retain independent origins for primary-analysis choices.
